boss_extra.hero_down: Another carcass for the marsh silt. Your bones will feed the willow roots.
boss_extra.big_hit: The swamp bears down with crushing weight!
boss_extra.enrage: The beast thrashes in a frenzy of black mud and snapping tusks!

hero_after.warrior: Stinking mire-beast. At least my boots are ruined.
hero_after.archer: Clean the mud from the bowstring. Let's move.
hero_after.mage: Ancient filth. It belongs under the silt.
hero_after.necromancer: Even in death, that beast has no soul worth pulling.

boss_extra.hero_down: The quarry is taken. Ironhide claims what he hunts.
boss_extra.big_hit: The rune-baked maul shatters your defenses!
boss_extra.enrage: Krell roars, his hide glowing with intense kiln-heat!

hero_after.warrior: His hide was tough, but cold iron is tougher.
hero_after.archer: He never saw the bolt through his visor.
hero_after.mage: A brute with a hammer. Nothing more.
hero_after.necromancer: Rest in the quarry slag, Krag. You're done.

boss_extra.hero_down: Ashbrook burns, and you burn with it. Pitiful.
boss_extra.big_hit: Cold iron and dark sorcery pierce your mail!
boss_extra.enrage: Morvessa's shadow swells, unleashing a storm of bitter spite!

hero_after.warrior: The witch talks too much. Steel speaks clearer.
hero_after.mage: A master of malice, devoid of true discipline.
hero_after.necromancer: Your spirits were weak, Morvessa. I expected more.

boss_extra.hero_down: Freeze in the alkali dust. Your campaign ends here.
boss_extra.big_hit: A shard of bleeding quartz tears through your armor!
boss_extra.enrage: Selene shatters her own spires, channeling raw freezing static!

hero_after.warrior: Cold blood in a cold woman. She's done.
hero_after.archer: Her quartz spires are dust. Let's check the loot.
hero_after.necromancer: Her frost couldn't match the cold in my ribs.

boss_extra.hero_down: Rot takes you. The hollow claims all intruders.
boss_extra.big_hit: Marrow-rot fire courses through your veins!
boss_extra.enrage: Voss shrieks, shattering bone trinkets as foul vapours rise!

hero_after.warrior: Smells like swamp gas and dead rats. Good riddance.
hero_after.archer: Burn her hut down. Leave nothing behind.
hero_after.mage: Primitive hexes. Easily unraveled with proper focus.
hero_after.necromancer: Her curses were clumsy. Amateurs always fail.

boss_extra.hero_down: Redmarsh is ours. Your corpse feeds the smelters.
boss_extra.big_hit: Gorrathul's heavy gauntlet crushes your breastplate!
boss_extra.enrage: The warlord slams his fists into the causeway, raining iron shrapnel!

hero_after.warrior: Heavy armor, heavier fall. Take his keys.
hero_after.archer: Ironheart has lost its master. Good.
hero_after.mage: His defenses were formidable, but brittle under arcana.
hero_after.necromancer: A mountain of iron reduced to a heap of scrap.

boss_extra.hero_down: Return to the deep water. The tide takes all.
boss_extra.big_hit: A rusted anchor sweeps you off the lighthouse stair!
boss_extra.enrage: Malakor swells with crashing surf, howling like a gale!

hero_after.warrior: Let the sea keep him. I'm soaked enough.
hero_after.archer: Climb higher before the tide catches us.
hero_after.mage: Drowned in his own delusions of grandeur.
hero_after.necromancer: The sea-stack is full of corpses. He fits right in.

boss_extra.hero_down: Crushed to dust beneath the weight of ages.
boss_extra.big_hit: A tectonic stomp shakes the very marrow from your bones!
boss_extra.enrage: The monolith's furnace core flares blinding white!

hero_after.warrior: Just a lot of old rock. My sword is notched.
hero_after.archer: That was an ugly climb. Glad it's over.
hero_after.mage: Bound magic collapsing into lifeless rubble.
hero_after.necromancer: Ancient chains couldn't hold it, but my blade did.

boss_extra.hero_down: Foreclosure complete. You die in debt.
boss_extra.big_hit: A poisoned sabre strikes deep beneath your ribs!
boss_extra.enrage: Draven laughs madly, kicking open his catacomb vault doors!

hero_after.archer: He won't extort another copper from the coast.
hero_after.mage: Greed made him sloppy. Death made him quiet.
hero_after.necromancer: His ledger is balanced in blood now.

boss_extra.hero_down: Burn in the harbor smoke. Victory belongs to the flame.
boss_extra.big_hit: White phosphorus splatters across your armor, burning fiercely!
boss_extra.enrage: Kael shatters his flagship wheel, igniting the entire deck!

hero_after.warrior: Arrogant captain. His ship is burning with him.
hero_after.archer: Good shot on his rigging. Now let's get ashore.
hero_after.mage: Phosphorus is a crude tool for a pyromancer.
hero_after.necromancer: He wanted fire so badly. Give him ashes.

boss_extra.hero_down: The tide sweeps you away. Silence claims the crags.
boss_extra.big_hit: A torrential wave of ley-salt vaporizes your shield!
boss_extra.enrage: The oracle levitates, screaming prophecies of absolute ruin!

hero_after.warrior: Prophecies didn't save him from steel.
hero_after.archer: His tide broke against our line.
hero_after.mage: He foresaw many things, but not this blade.
hero_after.necromancer: His future is very short and very flat.

boss_extra.hero_down: Crushed beneath iron tracks. The siege is absolute.
boss_extra.big_hit: Heavy ballista bolts punch straight through your barricade!
boss_extra.enrage: The leviathan vents high-pressure steam, grinding forward relentlessly!

hero_after.warrior: Takes more than iron plates to stop us.
hero_after.archer: A massive target. Hard to miss.
hero_after.mage: Mechanical folly powered by stolen force.
hero_after.necromancer: No soul in that machine. Just gears and oil.

boss_extra.hero_down: Heresy purged. You are nothing before the order.
boss_extra.big_hit: A consecrated spear drives you to your knees!
boss_extra.enrage: Varro smashes his altar, invoking blinding zealot fury!

hero_after.warrior: Fanatics are the loudest when they die.
hero_after.archer: His silent guards made more sense than he did.
hero_after.mage: Misguided zeal wrapped in old marble.
hero_after.necromancer: Your inquisitors are as hollow as your faith.

boss_extra.hero_down: Starlight consumes you. The vault remains sealed.
boss_extra.big_hit: Stellar fire obliterates your defenses in a blinding flash!
boss_extra.enrage: Vesperion unfurls celestial wings, raining blinding light!

hero_after.warrior: Fallen angel, fallen foe. Let's move on.
hero_after.archer: Too bright for my eyes. Glad he's down.
hero_after.mage: A magnificent manifestation of pure starlight, extinguished.
hero_after.necromancer: Light has no power in the dark.

boss_extra.hero_down: Return to the magma. The unchained fire is eternal.
boss_extra.big_hit: Magma surges from the throne vents, scorching your flesh!
boss_extra.enrage: Ashkarath shatters the conduit pillars, unleashing primordial fury!

hero_after.warrior: The fire is out, Warden. Rest in the ash.
hero_after.archer: That's the last of them. Pack up our gear.
hero_after.mage: The primordial flame is finally contained. At last.
hero_after.necromancer: An eternity of guarding fire, ended in seconds.
